entities.summary: Maurice Arnold de Forest, Count de Bendern  was an American-born British politician, soldier and early motor racing driver. He briefly served as a Liberal politician in the United Kingdom. He was ennobled, first as a baron in Austria and later as Count de Bendern in Liechtenstein.
